name: Theme settings
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and Theme settings.
The tagline and announcement here are fallbacks. If a header or announcement section supplies its own text, edit that section too. Any shipping promise must match an actual Shopify shipping rule.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.label: Site tagline
settings.how: Enter the site tagline. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Announcement bar text (fallback)
settings.how: Enter the announcement bar text (fallback). Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
